arXiv:2609.05284v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 9 月 4 日arXiv:2609.05284v1 [cs.AI] 04 Sep 2026

GUT：通过图复杂性量化和优化法学硕士的推理不确定性GUT: Quantifying and Optimizing the Reasoning Uncertainty of LLMs via Graph Complexity

Shuang Liang1,2  Xin-Yu Hu1,2  Xiang-Jun Ou2  Shao-Qun Zhang1,2,🖂
1 National Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology    Nanjing University    China.
2 School of Intelligent Science and Technology    Nanjing University    China.
zhangsq@lamda.nju.edu.cn
摘要Abstract

近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力取得了巨大进步。然而，法学硕士的推理过程经常表现出不确定性，法学硕士经常在每个推理步骤中产生大量不同的分支，即使输入相同的提示输入，并且某些分支表现出明显令人难以置信，甚至荒谬的推理链和结果。在本文中，我们提出了基于图复杂性的 UncerTainty (GUT) 方法来研究 LLM 的推理不确定性。 GUT的核心思想是用有向无环图来刻画每个推理链的潜在分支，从而确保所有潜在分支都被全面覆盖在图空间内。基于这种认识，我们进一步构建了两个 GUT 模块，即量化（GUT-Q）模块和优化（GUT-O）模块，分别用于量化和减少 LLM 的推理不确定性。 GUT-Q 通过用图复杂度近似推理空间复杂度来衡量 LLM 推理不确定性。 GUT-O通过将负不确定性视为强化学习中的奖励函数来实现不确定性优化。在四个法学硕士和五个数据集上进行的实验结果验证了 GUT 的有效性。Recent years have witnessed great advances in the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the reasoning processes of LLMs often exhibit uncertainty, where LLMs often produce a proliferation of divergent branches at each reasoning step even when fed the same prompting inputs, and certain branches exhibit evidently incredible, even nonsensical, reasoning chains and results. In this paper, we propose the Graph-complexity-based UncerTainty (GUT) method for investigating the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs. The key idea of GUT is to characterize the potential branches of each reasoning chain with a directed acyclic graph, thereby ensuring that all potential branches are comprehensively covered within the graph space. Building upon this recognition, we further build two modules of GUT, that is, a Quantification (GUT-Q) module and an Optimization (GUT-O) module, for quantifying and reducing the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs, respectively. GUT-Q measures LLM reasoning uncertainty by approximating the reasoning space complexity with graph complexity. GUT-O implements uncertainty optimization by treating negative uncertainty as the reward function in reinforcement learning. Experimental results conducted on four LLMs and five datasets validate the effectiveness of GUT.

关键词：Key words:大型语言模型、推理不确定性量化、推理不确定性优化、图复杂性Large Language Models, Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification, Reasoning Uncertainty Optimization, Graph Complexity

1 简介Introduction

当系统的内在随机性导致其输出或决策的可变性时，就会出现不确定性Uncertainty arises when the intrinsic stochasticity of the system results in the variability in its outputs or decisions(Raiffa, 1968)。特别是，当开发人员使用大型语言模型（LLM）进行推理时，他们经常会遇到源自令牌概率分布的基于温度的随机采样的推理不确定性，这反过来又会导致生成的推理链的可变性. In particular, when developers employ Large Language Models (LLMs) for reasoning, they frequently encounter the reasoning uncertainty originating from temperature-based stochastic sampling over token probability distributions, which in turn induces variability in the generated reasoning chains(Liu et al., 2025)。因此，量化和优化已广泛应用于医疗保健领域的LLM的推理不确定性是必要且有意义的。. Thus, it is necessary and significant to quantify and optimize the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs, which has been widely deployed in fields of medical care(Atf et al., 2025)、自动驾驶, autonomous driving(Wang et al., 2023)，以及量化交易, and quantitative trading(Nie et al., 2024).

人们在量化法学硕士的推理不确定性方面做出了很多努力。一个直观的方式就是提示LLM判断自己推理的不确定性There have been lots of efforts on quantifying the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs. An intuitive way is to prompt the LLM to judge its own reasoning uncertainty(Kadavath et al., 2022; Xiong et al., 2024)。然而，这种方式的有效性从根本上受到基于提示的生成过程固有的随机性的限制，这种随机性是由令牌级分布和随机采样引起的，从而递归地放大了LLM推理的不确定性。随后的研究将推理链建模为一个序列，在此基础上，研究人员通过利用单个采样序列的统计信息来量化LLM的推理不确定性. However, the effectiveness of this manner is fundamentally limited by the inherent stochasticity of the prompt-based generation process, induced by the token-level distribution and stochastic sampling, thus recursively amplifying the uncertainty in LLM reasoning. Subsequent studies modeled the reasoning chain as a sequence, based on which researchers quantified the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs by exploiting either the statistical information of a single sampled sequence(Lin et al., 2024a; Malinin and Gales, 2021)或多个采样序列的多样性or the diversity of multiple sampled sequences(Farquhar et al., 2024; Lin et al., 2024b)。然而，将推理链建模为简单序列无法准确捕捉 LLM 推理中固有的不确定性，因为它忽略了每个推理步骤中出现的潜在分支。最近的研究. Nevertheless, modeling reasoning chains as simple sequences fails to accurately capture the inherent uncertainty in LLM reasoning, as it overlooks the potential branches emerging at each individual reasoning step. Recent studies(Da et al., 2025; Mo and Xin, 2024; Zhang et al., 2025)构建图来显式建模推理步骤的潜在分支，并通过图的拓扑信息量化推理不确定性。基于图的方法实现了推理分支的相当精确的建模，但严重依赖于自我提示。因此，对由 token 级分布和随机采样引起的推理分支进行精确有效的表征对于量化 LLM 推理不确定性是必要且具有挑战性的。constructed graphs to explicitly model potential branches of reasoning steps and quantified the reasoning uncertainty by the topological information of graphs. The graph-based methods achieve a considerably precise modeling of reasoning branches, but rely heavily on self-prompting. Therefore, achieving a precise and effective characterization of the reasoning branches induced by both token-level distributions and stochastic sampling is necessary and challenging for quantifying the LLM reasoning uncertainty.

我们通过执行多次采样并将等效推理步骤与自然语言推理（NLI）模型合并来实现图建模，从而精确地表征每个推理步骤中的潜在分支并克服自我提示的有效性瓶颈。由于所有潜在分支的集合，即推理空间We implement graph modeling by performing multiple sampling and merging equivalent reasoning steps with a Natural Language Inference (NLI) model, thereby precisely characterizing potential branches in each reasoning step and overcoming effectiveness bottlenecks of self-prompting. Since the collection of all potential branches, that is, the reasoning space(Chen et al., 2025)，涵盖了随机采样引发的所有可能的推理链，我们可以利用图复杂度来近似推理空间复杂度。我们通过集成令牌级分布和拓扑信息的统计数据来构建图的复杂性。与现有的 UQ 方法相比，构造图复杂度是一种更全面的量化 LLM 推理不确定性的估计器，因为人们可以将推理不确定性追溯到令牌级分布和采样中的随机性。通过将基于图复杂性的不确定性和简单的代理近似作为奖励函数，我们可以在强化学习（RL）中构建优化问题，以减少 LLM 推理的不确定性。图, covers all possible reasoning chains induced by stochastic sampling, we can exploit the graph complexity to approximate reasoning space complexity. We construct the graph complexity by integrating statistics over token-level distributions and topological information. The constructed graph complexity is a more comprehensive estimator for quantifying LLM reasoning uncertainty than those of existing UQ methods, since one can trace the reasoning uncertainty back to the stochasticity in both token-level distributions and sampling. By taking the graph-complexity-based uncertainty with a simple proxy approximation as a reward function, we can build the optimization problem within Reinforcement Learning (RL) for reducing the LLM reasoning uncertainty. Figure1说明了我们量化和优化法学硕士推理不确定性的关键思想。illustrates our key ideas of quantifying and optimizing the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs.

基于上述认识，我们提出了基于图复杂性的UncerTainty（GUT）来量化和减少推理不确定性，包括量化（GUT-Q）模块和优化（GUT-O）模块。我们的贡献总结如下。首先，我们提出了 LLM 推理中 UQ 的 GUT-Q，它通过使用图复杂度估计推理空间复杂度来进行操作。 4 个法学硕士和 5 个数据集的经验证据表明，通过 AUROC、AUPRC 和 PRR 衡量，GUT-Q 在选择性生成的下游任务中优于 45 个 UQ 竞争者。其次，我们提出了 LLM 推理中不确定性优化（UO）的 GUT-O，它通过将负不确定性代理设置为 RL 框架中的奖励来运行。 4 个 LLM 量表和 5 个数据集的经验证据表明，GUT-O 有效降低了推理不确定性并提高了准确性。Based on the above recognition, we propose the Graph-complexity-based UncerTainty (GUT) for quantifying and reducing the reasoning uncertainty, comprising a Quantification (GUT-Q) module and an Optimization (GUT-O) module. Our contributions are summarized as follows. Firstly, we propose the GUT-Q for UQ in LLM reasoning that operates by estimating the reasoning space complexity with graph complexity. Empirical evidence across 4 LLMs and 5 datasets shows that the GUT-Q outperforms 45 UQ contenders in the downstream task of selective generation, measured by AUROC, AUPRC, and PRR. Secondly, we propose the GUT-O for Uncertainty Optimization (UO) in LLM reasoning that operates by setting the negative uncertainty proxy as the reward in the RL framework. Empirical evidence across 4 LLM scales and 5 datasets shows that GUT-O effectively reduces the reasoning uncertainty and improves the accuracy.

Section5进行实验来验证我们提出的 GUT 的有效性。部分conducts experiments to validate the effectiveness of our proposed GUT. Section6结束了这项工作。concludes this work.

2 相关工作Related Work

推理不确定性量化Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification

直观上，可以通过复杂的模板（例如基于多项选择的提示）提示法学硕士判断其自身推理的不确定性Intuitively, one can prompt the LLM to judge its own reasoning uncertainty with sophisticated templates such as multiple choice-based prompts(Kadavath et al., 2022)以及基于推理分解的提示and reasoning decomposition-based prompts(Xiong et al., 2024)。基于提示的生成过程表现出由令牌级别分布和随机采样引起的固有随机性，这会递归地放大LLM推理中的不确定性。因此，自我提示方式的有效性从根本上受到限制。通过将推理链建模为序列，后续研究通过利用单个采样序列的统计信息（如熵）来量化法学硕士的推理不确定性. The prompt-based generation process exhibits inherent stochasticity induced by token-level distribution and stochastic sampling, which recursively amplifies the uncertainty in LLM reasoning. Thus, self-prompting manners are fundamentally limited in their effectiveness. By modeling the reasoning chain as a sequence, subsequent studies quantified the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs through the exploitation of either the statistical information of a single sampled sequence like entropy(Malinin and Gales, 2021)和可能性and likelihood(Lin et al., 2024a)，或多个采样序列之间的多样性，例如偏心率, or the diversity among multiple sampled sequences such as eccentricity(Lin et al., 2024b)和语义簇的熵and the entropy of semantic clusters(Farquhar et al., 2024)。这些方法在很大程度上依赖于序列级建模的统计和信息论测量。然而，仅将推理链建模为序列无法准确捕获 LLM 推理中固有的不确定性，因为它忽略了每个推理步骤中出现的潜在分支。描述每个推理步骤的潜在分支的自然方法是使用图来显式建模推理空间，定义为问题的所有可能推理链的集合. These methods depend heavily on the statistical and information-theoretic measures upon the sequence-level modeling. Nevertheless, modeling reasoning chains merely as sequences fails to accurately capture the inherent uncertainty in LLM reasoning, since it neglects the potential branches emerging at each reasoning step. A natural approach to characterize potential branches at each reasoning step is to use a graph to explicitly model the reasoning space, defined as the set of all possible reasoning chains of a problem(Chen et al., 2025)。最近的研究通过图的拓扑信息（例如图距离）构建图并量化推理不确定性. Recent studies constructed graphs and quantified reasoning uncertainty by the topological information of graphs, such as graph distance(Da et al., 2025)和路径的数量and the number of paths(Zhang et al., 2025)。尽管基于图的方法实现了推理分支的相当精确的建模，但它们严重依赖于自我提示。因此，对令牌分布和随机采样引起的推理分支进行精确有效的表征以量化法学硕士的推理不确定性仍然是必要且具有挑战性的。. Although the graph-based methods achieve a considerably precise modeling of reasoning branches, they rely heavily on self-prompting. Therefore, it remains necessary and challenging to achieve a precise and effective characterization of the reasoning branches induced by token distributions and stochastic sampling for quantifying the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs.

推理不确定性优化Reasoning Uncertainty Optimization

人们对纳入不确定性措施以增强法学硕士推理的兴趣激增。There has been a surge of interest in incorporating uncertainty measures to enhance LLM reasoning.Bi et al. (2025)利用LLM logits来识别和防止ToT模型中高不确定性节点的扩展utilized LLM logits to identify and prevent the expansion of high-uncertainty nodes in the ToT modelYao et al. (2023)。一些研究通过利用令牌级分布的统计数据（例如熵）来检测并终止高度不确定的推理链的生成. Some studies detected and terminated the generation of highly uncertain reasoning chains by leveraging the statistics of token-level distributions, such as entropy(Fu et al., 2025), top-1 和 top-2 标记之间的概率差距, the probability gap between the top-1 and top-2 tokens(Zhu et al., 2025)，以及连续令牌位置之间的 logit 变化, and the logit variation between consecutive token positions(Yin et al., 2024)。因此，这些研究主要侧重于通过利用不确定性作为信号来探索推理空间，而不是减少推理的不确定性。因此，LLM推理中的UO在很大程度上仍未被探索。. Hence, these studies primarily focused on exploring the reasoning space by exploiting uncertainty as a signal, rather than reducing the reasoning uncertainty. Therefore, the UO in LLM reasoning remains largely unexplored.

如图As shown in Figure1，合并语义等效节点后，对于带有参数的LLM, after merging semantically equivalent nodes, for the LLM with parameterθ\theta和平坦的令牌级分布，第一个推理步骤有四个潜在分支和两个最终答案；而对于带参数的法学硕士and flat token-level distributions, there are four potential branches at the first reasoning step and two final answers; while for the LLM with parameterθ′\theta^{\prime}和峰值令牌级别分布，第一步只有两个潜在分支和一个最终答案。据观察，每一步的潜在分支越多，底层推理空间的拓扑就越复杂，其复杂性也越高。基于这一观察，很自然地可以通过推理空间的复杂性来量化推理的不确定性，而推理空间的复杂性可以通过图的复杂性来近似。and peak token-level distributions, there are only two potential branches at the first step and one final answer. 所提出的 GUT-Q 构建一个图来揭示每个步骤的潜在分支，然后量化步骤级不确定性以捕获标记级随机性，最后利用图复杂性来近似推理空间复杂性，从而能够估计推理不确定性。 GUT-Q 包括图构建、步骤级不确定性量化和图复杂性估计，详细信息请参见小节The proposed GUT-Q constructs a graph to reveal the potential branches of each step, then quantifies step-level uncertainty to capture token-level stochasticity, and finally exploits graph complexity to approximate reasoning space complexity, which in turn enables the estimation of reasoning uncertainty. GUT-Q comprises graph construction, step-level uncertainty quantification, and graph complexity estimation, detailed in Subsections3.1, 3.2, 和, and3.3，分别。, respectively.

3.1 图构建Graph Construction

本小节正式阐述了 GUT-Q 如何构造有向无环图 (DAG) 来表征推理空间。关键思想是首先用多个 CoT 链初始化一个 DAG，然后合并语义等效的节点，以揭示推理空间中每个步骤的内在潜在分支。我们从抽样开始This subsection formalizes how GUT-Q constructs a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to characterize the reasoning space. The key idea is to first initialize a DAG with multiple CoT chains and then merge semantically equivalent nodes to uncover the intrinsic potential branches of each step within the reasoning space. We begin by samplingK∈ℕ+K\in\mathbb{N}^{+}推理链reasoning chains{ci}i∈[K]\{c^{i}\}_{i\in[K]}并提取推理步骤and extracting reasoning steps{sji}j∈[ni]\{s^{i}_{j}\}_{j\in[n_{i}]}为了forni∈ℕ+n_{i}\in\mathbb{N}^{+}。接下来，我们初始化一个以问题为根源的 DAG. Next, we initialize a DAG rooted at the problemxx。该 DAG 包含代表推理步骤的节点. This DAG comprises nodes representing reasoning stepssjis_{j}^{i}。这些节点通过指向下一步的有向边连接。具体来说，有向边连接根. These nodes are connected by directed edges that point to the next step. Specifically, directed edges connect the rootxx到最初的步骤to the initial stepss1is_{1}^{i}并链接后续步骤and link subsequent stepssj−1is_{j-1}^{i} to sjis_{j}^{i}。每条路径终止于代表最终答案的叶节点. Each path terminates at a leaf node representing the final answersniis^{i}_{n_{i}}，对于 MATH-500 等数学数据集来说，它通常是实值标量或向量。, which is typically a real-valued scalar or vector for mathematical datasets like MATH-500.

直观上，可以通过三种方式来合并语义等价的节点。首先，可以提示LLM判断两个节点的等价性。该方法存在较高的 LLM 推理成本和基于提示的生成固有的随机性。其次，当两个节点对应嵌入的余弦相似度超过预先指定的阈值时，就可以建立等价性。该方法可能需要针对特定​​任务选择嵌入模型并仔细调整该阈值。第三，如果两个节点被 NLI 模型双向蕴含，即一个节点蕴涵另一个节点，则认为它们是等效的，反之亦然。该方法通过运行小规模 NLI 模型来产生确定性蕴涵判断，从而克服了前两种方法的局限性。因此，作为本工作的示例，我们采用第三种实现并在小节中验证其有效性Intuitively, there are three ways to merge semantically equivalent nodes. First, one can prompt an LLM to judge the equivalence of two nodes. This method suffers from high LLM inference costs and the inherent stochasticity of prompt-based generation. Second, equivalence can be established when the cosine similarity of the two nodes’ corresponding embeddings exceeds a pre-specified threshold. This method may require a task-specific choice of embedding model and careful tuning of this threshold. Third, two nodes are considered equivalent if they are bidirectionally entailed by an NLI model, i.e., a node entails the other and vice versa. This approach overcomes the limitations of the previous two methods by running a small-scale NLI model that yields deterministic entailment judgments. Thus, as an example in this work, we adopt the third implementation and validate its effectiveness in Subsection5.1和附录and AppendixB。当两个节点合并时，有向边将重定向到新形成的节点。值得注意的是，我们以基于 AOV 的顺序遍历节点对. When two nodes are merged, the directed edges are redirected to the newly formed node. Notably, we traverse the node pairs in the AOV-based order(Horowitz et al., 1976)确保合并后图仍然是 DAG，这是对所有节点对的简单遍历无法保留的属性。图to ensure that the graph remains a DAG after merging, a property that a naive traversal over all node pairs cannot preserve. A largerU⁡(tj)U(t_{j})表明代币的不确定性较高indicates higher uncertainty of tokentjt_{j}。接下来，我们执行组级聚合：. Next, we perform group-level aggregation asUi=∑j=ii+w−1U⁡(tj)/wU_{i}=\sum\nolimits_{j=i}^{i+w-1}{U(t_{j})}/w，产生一个集合, yielding a set{Ui}i∈[m−w+1]\{U_{i}\}_{i\in[m-w+1]}为了forw∈[m]w\in[m]。这种方法的目的是捕捉推理步骤中的局部不确定性，这是一个简单的平均值. 3.3 图复杂度估计Graph Complexity Estimation

在本小节中，我们通过利用节点不确定性和图拓扑来量化推理不确定性来构建图复杂性，如图所示In this subsection, we construct graph complexity by exploiting node uncertainty and graph topology to quantify reasoning uncertainty, as illustrated in Figure1。具体来说，我们介绍了三种图复杂度估计方法，包括宽度（GUT-Q-W）、高度（GUT-Q-H）和不确定性传播（GUT-Q-UP）。. Specifically, we introduce three graph complexity estimation methods, including Width (GUT-Q-W), Height (GUT-Q-H), and Uncertainty Propagation (GUT-Q-UP).

GUT-Q-W

直观的是，首先找到宽度路径上的节点，然后对这些节点上的节点不确定性求和。 DAG 的宽度表示推理空间中任何单个步骤的最大分支数。大宽度表示至少存在一个具有许多潜在分支的步骤。因此，宽度路径上节点不确定性的总和，即不确定性加权宽度It is intuitive to first find the nodes on the width path and then sum the node uncertainty over these nodes. The width of a DAG represents the maximum number of branches at any single step in the reasoning space. A large width indicates the existence of at least one step with numerous potential branches. Thus, the sum of node uncertainty over the width path, that is, uncertainty-weighted widthWuW_{u}，可以反映潜在推理分支的分歧。求宽度的关键思想是首先进行拓扑排序, can reflect the divergence of potential reasoning branches. The key idea for finding the width is to first perform topological sorting(Cormen et al., 2022)获得节点的拓扑顺序，然后找到同一拓扑级别的最大节点数。算法to obtain the topological order of the nodes and then find the maximum number of nodes at the same topological level. Algorithm1总结一下计算过程summarizes the calculation process ofWuW_{u}用于估计图的复杂性。for estimating graph complexity.

GUT-Q-H

与 GUT-Q-W 对偶，我们可以找到高度路径上的节点，然后对它们的节点不确定性求和。 DAG 的高度表示从根到叶节点的最长推理链的长度，通过沿该路径的边数来衡量。高度大表明存在至少一个具有多个步骤的推理链。因此，高度路径上的节点不确定性之和，即不确定性加权高度，捕获了推理空间的深度和沿该路径的令牌级随机性。求高度的关键思想是首先进行拓扑排序，得到节点的拓扑顺序，确定最大拓扑层级，然后选择跨这些层级的由边连接的节点序列。算法Dual to GUT-Q-W, one can find the nodes on the height path and then sum the node uncertainty over them. The height of a DAG represents the length of the longest reasoning chain from the root to a leaf node, measured by the number of edges along this path. A large height indicates the existence of at least one reasoning chain with numerous steps. Hence, the sum of node uncertainty over the height path, namely uncertainty-weighted height, captures both the depth of the reasoning space and the token-level stochasticity along this path. The key idea of finding the height is to first perform topological sorting to obtain the topological order of the nodes, identify the maximum topological level, and then select a sequence of nodes across these levels that are connected by edges. Algorithm3在附录中in AppendixA.2列出了 GUT-Q-H 用于图复杂性估计的过程。lists the procedure of GUT-Q-H for graph complexity estimation.

肠-Q-UPGUT-Q-UP

GUT-Q-W 和 GUT-Q-H 可能无法充分利用节点不确定性GUT-Q-W and GUT-Q-H may not fully exploit node uncertaintyU⁡(v)U(v)或节点之间的详细连接。因此，我们建议 GUT-Q-UP 来更充分地利用它们。由于 DAG 本质上是前馈神经网络 (FNN)or the detailed connectivity among nodes. Thus, we propose GUT-Q-UP to make fuller use of them. Since a DAG is naturally a Feedforward Neural Network (FNN)(Scarselli et al., 2008)不确定性随着推理步骤不断累积and uncertainty accumulates along reasoning steps(Gan et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2024b)，传播节点不确定性是直观的, it is intuitive to propagate node uncertaintyU⁡(v)U(v)从第一个推理步骤开始from the first reasoning steps{s1i}i∈[K]\{s^{i}_{1}\}_{i\in[K]}到辅助节点to an auxiliary nodesas_{a}，其中所有最终答案节点, where all final-answer nodes{snii}i∈[K]\{s_{n_{i}}^{i}\}_{i\in[K]}指向它。因此，point to it. Therefore,U⁡(sa)U(s_{a})，该 FNN 在前向传播后的输出，包含了在整个推理空间中传播的节点不确定性。算法, the output of this FNN after forward propagation, incorporates node uncertainty propagated throughout the reasoning space. Algorithm2概述了估计图复杂度的 GUT-Q-UP 算法，其中节点不确定性outlines the GUT-Q-UP algorithm to estimate graph complexity, where the node uncertaintyU⁡(v)U(v)用于初始化与相关的 FNN 的偏差is used to initialize the biases of the FNN associated withGG。算法. Algorithm4在附录中in AppendixA.2列出了一个初始化该 FNN 权重的变体lists a variant that initializes this FNN’s weights withU⁡(v)U(v).

GUT-Q-W 和 GUT-Q-H 在可解释性方面优于 GUT-Q-UP，因为它们表征了推理空间的内在拓扑； GUT-Q-W 捕获任何单个步骤中潜在分支的最大数量，GUT-Q-H 整合最长推理链的长度。相比之下，GUT-Q-UP 在选择性生成的下游任务中通常优于 GUT-Q-W 和 GUT-Q-HGUT-Q-W and GUT-Q-H excel in explainability over GUT-Q-UP, since they characterize the intrinsic topology of the reasoning space; GUT-Q-W captures the maximum number of potential branches at any single step, and GUT-Q-H integrates the length of the longest reasoning chain. In contrast, GUT-Q-UP typically outperforms GUT-Q-W and GUT-Q-H in the downstream task of selective generation(Ren et al., 2023)，如小节中的经验证据所示, as shown by the empirical evidence in Subsection5.1。这些发现揭示了这三种图复杂性估计方法的使用场景，其中可以使用 GUT-Q-W 和 GUT-Q-H 来解释推理空间的内在拓扑，并使用 GUT-Q-UP 来执行选择性生成的下游任务。. These findings reveal the usage scenarios of these three graph complexity estimation methods, where one may employ the GUT-Q-W and GUT-Q-H for the explainability of the intrinsic topology of the reasoning space, and employ the GUT-Q-UP for the downstream task of selective generation.

5 实验Experiments

在本节中，我们进行实验来验证所提出的 GUT 框架。进行实验是为了回答（Q1）所提出的 UQ 是否以及在多大程度上有助于区分经典 UQ 方法的正确和错误生成，以及（Q2）所提出的 GUT-O 是否以及在多大程度上减少了基于图复杂性的不确定性。In this section, we conduct experiments to validate the proposed GUT framework. The experiments are performed to answer (Q1) whether and to what extent the proposed UQ can contribute to discriminating between correct and incorrect generations over classical UQ methods, and (Q2) whether and to what extent the proposed GUT-O reduces the graph-complexity-based uncertainty.

These observations show that GUT-Q outperforms the best UQ contenders by an average of11.7911.79PRR 百分比，% in PRR,13.3313.33AUROC 百分比，以及% in AUROC, and9.669.66AUPRC 中的百分比，跨越四个评估的法学硕士和五个数据集，回答了问题 1。此外，GUT-Q 表现出与现有的最先进方法（例如 SE 和 Eig-C）相当的运行时复杂性，其中附录% in AUPRC, across four evaluated LLMs and five datasets, which answers Q1. Moreover, GUT-Q exhibits comparable runtime complexity to existing start-of-the-art methods such as SE and Eig-C, where AppendixB.4提供了详细的分析。provides a detailed analysis.

5.2 GUT-O 验证Verifications on GUT-O

本小节通过比较平均不确定性来验证所提出的 GUT-O 模块的有效性This subsection validates the effectiveness of the proposed GUT-O module by comparing the mean uncertaintyYe et al. (2024)数据集上的法学硕士，定义为of an LLM on a dataset, defined asU⁡(D,θ)=∑x∈DU⁡(x,θ)/|D|U(D;\theta)=\sum\nolimits_{x\in D}{U(x;\theta)/|D|}，使用 GUT-O 之前和之后。 GUT-Q 得出的平均不确定性降低得越多，表明 UO 性能越好。我们使用 GRPO 作为竞争者。, before and after using GUT-O. A greater reduction in GUT-Q-derived mean uncertainty indicates better UO performance. We use GRPO as a contender.

表Table3显示了 4 个 Qwen3 LLM 在 MATH-500 数据集上的 UO 性能比较，其中“+”表示应用的微调方法，括号中的值表示平均不确定性的百分比变化。有两个关键的观察结果。首先，采用 GUT-O 后，所有三个 GUT-Q 派生的平均不确定性都会降低，而准确性会提高。这一观察结果验证了 GUT-O 的有效性。其次，据观察，在应用 GRPO 后，平均不确定性通常相当甚至增加，这表明 GUT-O 的 UO 性能主要受益于 MTLP 优化目标，而不是特定于任务的微调。类似的观察结果适用于所有 4 个评估的法学硕士和 5 个数据集，如表所示shows the comparisons of UO performance for 4 Qwen3 LLMs on the MATH-500 dataset, where ‘+’ indicates the applied fine-tuning method, and values in parentheses indicate the percentage change in mean uncertainty. There are two key observations. First, after employing GUT-O, all three GUT-Q-derived mean uncertainties decrease while the accuracy improves. This observation validates the effectiveness of GUT-O. Second, it is observed that mean uncertainties are typically comparable or even increase after applying GRPO, which suggests that the UO performance of GUT-O primarily benefits from the MTLP optimization target rather than task-specific fine-tuning. Similar observations hold for all 4 evaluated LLMs and 5 datasets, as shown in Table14在附录中in AppendixC.2。这些结果表明，GUT-O 在 4 个法学硕士和 5 个数据集上分别降低了推理不确定性，并将准确性平均提高了 13.95% 和 1.93%，这回答了第二个问题。. These findings demonstrate that GUT-O separately reduces reasoning uncertainty and improves accuracy by an average of 13.95% and 1.93% across 4 LLMs and 5 datasets, which answers Q2.

6 结论Conclusions

在本文中，我们通过使用 DAG 来表征每个推理步骤的潜在分支，研究了 LLM 的推理不确定性。基于这种认识，我们提出了由 GUT-Q 和 GUT-O 组成的 GUT，分别用于量化和减少推理不确定性。 GUT-Q通过推理空间复杂度来量化推理不确定性，推理空间复杂度由DAG的复杂度来近似。 GUT-O将负不确定性代理定义为GRPO方法中的奖励，进一步降低了推理的不确定性。实证结果表明，GUT-Q-UP 在 PRR 上平均超过 UQ 最佳竞争者 11.79%，在 AUROC 上平均超过 13.33%，在 AUPRC 上平均超过 9.66%。 GUT-O 降低推理不确定性，平均提高准确度 13.95% 和 1.93%。In this paper, we investigated the reasoning uncertainty of LLMs by using DAGs to characterize the potential branches of each reasoning step. Built upon this recognition, we proposed the GUT comprising GUT-Q and GUT-O for quantifying and reducing reasoning uncertainty, respectively. The GUT-Q quantifies reasoning uncertainty by the reasoning space complexity, which is approximated by the complexity of the DAG. Defining the negative uncertainty proxy as the reward in the GRPO method, the GUT-O further reduces reasoning uncertainty. Empirical results showed that GUT-Q-UP surpasses the best UQ contenders by an average of 11.79% in PRR, 13.33% in AUROC, and 9.66% in AUPRC. GUT-O reduces reasoning uncertainty and improves accuracy by an average of 13.95% and 1.93%, respectively.

Before that, we review the origin of reasoning uncertainty in LLMs, which has been illustrated in Figure1并在章节中介绍and introduced in Section3。给定一个问题，LLM系统的随机性源于代币级别的分布。该分布上的自回归随机温度采样会产生输出推理链的可变性，最终导致推理不确定性。这项工作的重点是量化和优化推理不确定性。. Given a problem, the stochasticity of the LLM system originates from the token-level distribution. The autoregressively stochastic temperature sampling over this distribution yields variability in the output reasoning chains, which ultimately gives rise to reasoning uncertainty. This work focuses on quantifying and optimizing reasoning uncertainty.

我们对相关数据集的 max_new_tokens 超参数进行了敏感性分析。 max_new_tokens 控制 LLM 可以生成的最大令牌数量。因此，较大的 max_new_tokens 表示较高的计算成本。然而，较低的 max_new_tokens 可能会导致生成不完整，例如缺少附录中提供的提示模板中所需的“最终答案”We conducted sensitivity analyses to the max_new_tokens hyperparameter for the concerned datasets. The max_new_tokens controls the maximum number of tokens that the LLM can generate. Hence, a larger max_new_tokens indicates higher computational cost. However, a lower max_new_tokens may lead to incomplete generations, such as missing the “Final Answer” that is required in our prompt template provided in AppendixA.1。因此，max_new_tokens 和完整生成率之间需要进行权衡。图. Therefore, there is a trade-off between the max_new_tokens and the complete generation rate. B.4 GUT-Q 及其竞争者的运行时复杂性分析Runtime Complexity Analysis of GUT-Q and Its Contenders

本小节提供了 GUT-Q 及其竞争者的运行时复杂性分析。具体来说，我们选择了八种代表性方法，即 Ppl、MCSE、SE、P(True)、CoT-UQ-ME、Eig-E、CoT-UQ-SP 和 Topo-UQ，以涵盖所有研究类别。所考虑的 UQ 方法的运行时间主要由三个部分组成，按计算成本降序排列，即 LLM 推理、辅助模型执行和其他特定计算，例如计算 token 级统计数据和推导相似度矩阵的特征值。像 Qwen3 这样的现代法学硕士通常在十亿个参数规模上运行，而辅助模型通常有数百万个参数。因此，LLM 推理的时间明显长于辅助模型，这使得 UQ 方法的整体运行时间主要由 LLM 推理的数量决定。This subsection provides a runtime complexity analysis of GUT-Q and its contenders. Specifically, we select eight representative methods, namely Ppl, MCSE, SE, P(True), CoT-UQ-ME, Eig-E, CoT-UQ-SP, and Topo-UQ, to cover all investigated categories. The runtime of the considered UQ methods primarily consists of three parts arranged in decreasing order of computational cost, namely LLM inference, auxiliary model execution, and other specific computations such as calculating token-level statistics and deriving the eigenvalues of the similarity matrix. Modern LLMs like Qwen3 typically operate at the billion-parameter scale, whereas auxiliary models usually have millions of parameters. Thus, LLM inference is significantly longer than that of the auxiliary model, which makes the overall runtime of a UQ method primarily dominated by the number of LLM inferences.

表Table8显示了 GUT-Q 及其竞争者的运行时复杂度比较，其中shows the runtime complexity comparison of GUT-Q and its contenders, whereK∈ℕ+K\in\mathbb{N}^{+}是 CoT 样本的数量，is the number of CoT samples,S∈ℕ+S\in\mathbb{N}^{+}表示 CoT 链中的平均推理步骤数，denotes the average number of reasoning steps in a CoT chain,L∈ℕ+L\in\mathbb{N}^{+}标记每个指定的构造图数量，marks the per-specified number of constructed graphs,n∈ℕ+n\in\mathbb{N}^{+}表示通过提示LLM分解的子问题的数量，indicates the number of subproblems decomposed by prompting the LLM,|V|∈ℕ+|{}V|{}\in\mathbb{N}^{+}是图中的顶点数，并且is the number of vertices in the graph, and|E|∈ℕ+|{}E|{}\in\mathbb{N}^{+}是图中的边数。由于 SE 和我们提出的 GUT-Q 依赖于辅助模型引导的链级或步骤级合并，因此当所有链或步骤属于同一集群时，它们的最佳情况就会发生，而当每个链或步骤形成不同的集群时，就会出现最坏情况。有两个关键的观察结果。首先，与代表性的基于多样性的 UQ 方法（例如 SE 和 Eig-E）相比，我们提出的 GUT-Q 共享相同数量的 LLM 提示，但需要稍多数量的辅助模型执行。其次，与 Topo-UQ 等经典的基于图的方法相比，我们提出的 GUT-Q 展示了相当数量的 LLM 提示和辅助模型执行。上述两个观察结果表明，我们提出的 GUT-Q 运行时复杂度与所研究的基于多样性和基于图的 UQ 方法相当，这些方法通常在选择性生成中比相关的基于信息的方法和基于反射的方法实现相对更好的 UQ 性能，如第 1 节所示。is the number of edges in the graph. Because SE and our proposed GUT-Q rely on chain-level or step-level merging guided by an auxiliary model, their best-case scenario occurs when all chains or steps belong to the same cluster, while the worst-case scenario arises when each forms a distinct cluster. There are two key observations. First, compared to representative diversity-based UQ methods such as SE and Eig-E, our proposed GUT-Q shares the same number of LLM prompts while requiring a slightly larger number of auxiliary model executions. Second, compared with classical graph-based methods like Topo-UQ, our proposed GUT-Q exhibits a comparable number of LLM prompts and auxiliary model executions. The above two observations suggest that our proposed GUT-Q runtime complexity is comparable to the investigated diversity-based and graph-based UQ methods, which typically achieve relatively better UQ performance in selective generation than the concerned information-based methods and reflexive-based methods, as shown in Section5.

图Figure4使用 Qwen3-4B 进一步可视化 GUT-Q 及其竞争者在 MATH-500 数据集上的平均挂钟时间比较，其中我们设置further visualizes the average wall-clock time comparison of GUT-Q and its contenders on the MATH-500 dataset using Qwen3-4B, where we setK=10K=10和andL=5L=5使 LLM 推理成本具有可比性。据观察，GUT-Q 的挂钟时间与现有最先进的方法（如 SE、Eig-E 和 Topo-UQ）相当，这证实了上述运行时分析和相应的结论。我们还可以观察到，GUT-Q的采样时间仅为Ppl方法的2.5倍左右，远小于to make LLM inference cost comparable.
